app.title: Car accident support
lang.label: Language
common.mapError: The map could not be loaded. Make sure the whole folder (including "vendor") is uploaded next to index.html.
start.title: Is everyone all right?
start.intro: Your safety comes first. Please confirm that you and everyone else at the scene are unhurt.
start.yes.title: Yes, everyone is all right.
start.emergency.title: No, emergency!
safety.title: Roadside safety
safety.intro: Make sure you follow the safety suggestions:
safety.hazard.title: Hazard lights active
safety.hazard.text: Turn on your hazard lights to warn approaching drivers that your vehicle has stopped.
safety.vest.title: High-visibility vest worn
safety.vest.text: Put on your vest before leaving the car so other drivers can see you clearly.
safety.triangle.title: Warning triangle placed
safety.triangle.text: Place the triangle well behind your vehicle, about 50 meters on regular roads and 100 meters on highways, to give traffic time to slow down.
police.title: Police involvement
police.intro: Check that the accident meets the criteria for not involving the police:
police.damage.title: Damage is less than €8,000
police.damage.text: Each of the affected vehicles is only lightly damaged, with damage cost estimate below €8,000
police.third.title: No damage to a 3rd party
police.third.text: There is no damage to a third party property - like damaged fence, parked cars or a building.
police.agree.title: Both drivers agree
police.agree.text: You and the other driver agree on what happened and on the damage to both cars.
police.warn: If the damage on either vehicle is above €8,000, or a third party was damaged, you should call the police.
location.title: Accident location
location.intro: Confirm the location where the accident occurred:
location.notfound: We couldn't find that address. Try adding the city.
details.title: Accident details
details.intro: Fill in the details of your accident:
details.map.prompt: Tap on the area damaged in the accident
details.witness.name: Witness name
photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Take photos of the damage on your vehicle:
photos.estimate: Based on your photos, we estimate the damage at €6,400 – €7,600. This is only an estimate made by AI – the final cost may differ after a further inspection at the service station. If there are additional damages, the total may exceed the legal threshold – in that case, you will be required to call the police.
cam.hint.vehicle: Take a photo of the damage
cam.hint.doc: Place the document inside the frame
sketch.title: Accident sketch
docs.title: Driver information
docs.f.name: Name and Surname
login.title: Log in
login.sub: Use your account to fill in your contact details.
share.title: Share form
share.intro: Choose how the other party will fill in the form:
share.qr.title: Share QR code
share.qr.text: The other party scans the code and fills in the form in their own browser.
share.sms.title: SMS / Email invitation
share.sms.text: We send them a link to the same online form.
share.device.title: Use this device
share.device.text: Hand over your phone so they can fill in the form themselves.
share.paper.title: Paper form
share.paper.text: Second driver fills the paper form and you can scan it to your app.
share.none.title: Can’t or won’t fill in
share.none.text: The other party is unable or unwilling to complete the form.
waiting.text: Waiting for the other driver to finish filling the report.
sign.title: Sign
sign.intro: Choose a method of signing the form:
sign.bankid.title: BankID
sign.bankid.text: Log in with BankID and sign document digitally.
sign.sms.title: Text message
sign.sms.text: Get a confirmation code via text message.
sign.hand.title: Handwritten signature
sign.hand.text: Use your screen to write your signature manually.
summary.title: Report ready
summary.text: Download a PDF and send it to your insurance company or simply submit it to them right from the app.
summary.book.title: Book a service
summary.tow.title: Tow vehicle
summary.toast.dl: PDF download is not available in this prototype
summary.toast.tow: Towing is not available in this prototype
summary.modal.title: Form submitted
summary.modal.text: Your accident report was successfully sent to {insurer}. You will receive a confirmation by email.
services.title: Book a service
services.nomore: No more services in this prototype
consent.title: Book a service
consent.agree.title: Agree to share my accident details
consent.agree.text: I agree with sharing details of my accident with the vehicle service, including photos, description, vehicle type and insurance details.
consent.sentTo: Your booking request has been sent to {service}. The service will contact you shortly.
consent.sent: Your booking request has been sent. The service will contact you shortly.
voice.title: Voice assistant
voice.hero.title: Tell us what happened
voice.hero.text: I will ask a few short questions about the accident and your vehicle damage. Answer by voice – or type if you prefer.
voice.hello: Hi, I’m your accident assistant. I’ll ask a few quick questions.
voice.q.intro: Let’s start. Please describe what happened in your own words.
voice.ack.intro: Thank you, I’ve noted that down.
voice.q.vehicles: How many other vehicles were involved?
voice.retry.vehicles: Sorry, I didn’t catch the number. How many other vehicles were involved?
voice.q.damage: Where is your own vehicle damaged?
voice.retry.damage: Sorry, I’m not sure which part that is. You can say for example “rear left” or choose from the options.
voice.retry.witnesses: Sorry, was there any witness – yes or no?
voice.q.wcontact: And a phone number or email to reach them?
voice.retry.wmore: Sorry, is there another witness – yes or no?
voice.photos.one: Thanks. Now I need one photo of the damage – {list}.
voice.photos.many: Thanks. Now I need {n} photos of the damage – {list}.
voice.photos.ask: Please take a photo of the {angle} of your vehicle.
voice.sum.intro: That’s everything I need for this part. Here is a summary:
voice.sum.next: You can now continue with the accident sketch.
voice.toast.unsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser – please type
voice.toast.nomic: Microphone not available – please type your answer
voice.toast.unavailable: Voice input is not available – please type
voice.re.namePrefix: it'?s|his name is|her name is|name is|they are|that'?s
